liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.problem: The playground host body used the title-spanning section-full grid area and overlapped the package header.
liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.result: The body now begins at the search row; the header bottom and body top both resolve to 174 CSS px without overlap.

liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.problem: The playground fixture used arbitrary 224 x 96 inner leaf dimensions.
liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.result: The fixture now produces the frozen reference's 200 x 122 inner and 202 x 124 outer leaf dimensions.

liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.problem: A later Tailwind p-1 utility reduced reset zoom from the reference's 26 x 26 to 24 x 24.
liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.result: The package fork rule owns the live 5 px padding again; reset zoom is 26 x 26 with a 12 x 12 icon.

liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.problem: The package canvas inherited the playground's near-black host surface and omitted the frozen fork's SVG grid.
liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.result: The package owns the exact reference canvas surfaces and zoom-aware grid: dark rgb(28, 35, 49) with #2b364a dots, light rgb(148, 163, 184) with #afbacf dots, and a 15 px default gap.

liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.problem: Invalid-drop feedback stayed inside the target section's stacking context and appeared behind the opaque free-move preview.
liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.result: Drop feedback is portaled to the body at z-index 1001, one layer above the free-move preview at z-index 1000.
liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.parityClassification: Developer-directed correction that intentionally supersedes the frozen stacking behavior.

liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.problem: Cross-parent insertion inherited direction-sensitive trailing-edge logic, so tiny downward pointer motion could show the placeholder after the first child on entry.
liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.result: Cross-parent insertion uses the dragged section's leading edge; same-parent sorting retains direction-aware edge selection and its 10 px hysteresis.
liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.parityClassification: Developer-directed correction that intentionally supersedes the frozen cross-parent edge choice.

liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.problem: The leading-edge correction fixed entry placement but made top-to-bottom switching require the dragged section's top edge to cross the frozen target midpoint, biasing the threshold by the preview height.
liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.result: Cross-parent insertion compares the pointer with the frozen target midpoint and preserves a symmetric 10 px dead band; vertical and horizontal transitions are covered. Same-parent sorting continues to use directional edges.
liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.parityClassification: Developer-directed collision correction recovered from the pre-directional-edge implementation history and scoped to cross-parent moves.

liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.problem: Placeholder insertion moved the nested target down 132 px (midpoint 486 to 618), and alternating group/child collision winners caused the single global hysteresis snapshot to forget the child's original geometry.
liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.result: The tracker now preserves the first geometry and current past-halfway state independently for each collision target. Alternating winners no longer shift the pointer threshold; the temporary trace was removed and a focused regression recreates the displacement.
liveFixesClosedBeforePresentation.parityClassification: Principled correction to make target-local hysteresis state match target-local insertion decisions.

canvasBackground.behavior: Grid translation, gap, and mark size track the package viewport transform exactly as in the frozen XYFlow fork.
